system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"Anyone else’s <USER> app totally not working? I get an error message whenever I try to search or play a non-downloaded song. 😫!?️"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! That sounds frustrating. Can you let us know what device and Spotify version you're using? We'll see what we can suggest! 
Keep us posted!"
text: {"send_unedited": true, "reason": "Friendly, clear, and requests necessary info to assist further."}
